name: Gulthias Tree

actions.name: Vampiric Roots
actions.effect: Roots erupt beneath a target within 18m. The Gulthias Tree heals for half the damage dealt.

actions.name: Blight Storm
actions.effect: Spawns 1d4 Twig Blights, 1d4 Needle Blights, or 1d4 Vine Blights at locations within 18m. The blights act immediately after the tree.

actions.name: Corruption Wave
actions.effect: All creatures within 12m must pass WILL save. On failure, they take full damage and are cursed: regeneration and healing effects are halved for 1 minute.

actions.name: Grasping Vines
actions.effect: Up to 3 creatures within 9m must pass PHYS save or be grappled and pulled to the tree's base.

reactions.name: Blight Shield
reactions.effect: When targeted by an attack, the Gulthias Tree commands a blight within 3m to intercept the attack, taking the damage instead.

reactions.name: Dark Regeneration
reactions.effect: At end of any turn, the tree heals 10 HP. Does not function if it took fire or radiant damage that turn.

traits.name: Corruption Aura
traits.desc: All non-plant creatures within 18m have -1d6 to saves against the tree's effects. Plants within this radius become blights over time.

traits.name: Immobile
traits.desc: The Gulthias Tree cannot move. However, its roots extend 18m in all directions.

traits.name: Vampiric Origin
traits.desc: The Gulthias Tree grew from a stake driven through a vampire's heart. It retains vampiric traits: blood drain, aversion to radiant damage, and the ability to corrupt living things.

lore: The Gulthias Tree is a cursed, vampiric tree that grew from a stake driven through a vampire's heart. It spreads corruption across the land, spawning armies of blights and draining the life force from everything around it. Only fire and radiant energy can truly end its dark reign.
